style: avant-garde cabaret art-rock | subharmonic undertone-derived field with microtonal pure interval friction | angular phrasing with yodel register flips and rests carrying contour | polymetric 5:4 and polyrhythmic 3:2 under contact-pulse exertion decay | daxophone, gamelan metallophones, bağlama, kamancheh, persian santur, zurna, duduk, and riq playing distinct register roles | camp theatrical overstatement under severe sensory overload | extreme-latency radio transmission with close-miked acoustic instruments, dynamic saturation curves, unpredictable flutter, phase cancellation anomalies, warm tape saturation artifacts, chaotic spatial panning movements, and heavy analog abrasion, interwoven with erratic frequency modulations, unpredictable transient spikes, erratic spectral shifts, dense harmonic distortion cascades, spectral smearing, unstable feedback loops, erratic gating, resonant ringing, micro-delays, and sudden spatial collapses.

caption: An avant-garde theatrical art-rock piece exploring the existential horror of waking up trapped in organic matter, driven by Ubykh-transferred vocal choirs, daxophone, gamelan, and traditional Asian instruments under extreme-latency transmission conditions.
